metadata.title: Chronos — Your relaxation preferences
metadata.intro: Tell us the styles, atmospheres and kinds of content you tend to enjoy. Choose what feels closer to your taste; you will decide what to use in each session later.
metadata.disclaimer: Chronos is a wellness tool, not a clinical assessment or treatment.
metadata.validation_status: Research-informed, not a validated questionnaire. No predictive accuracy, personality classification or clinical effectiveness is claimed.
metadata.source_numbering: R numbers refer to the preceding 30-paper reading list.
limitations: Narrator gender, accent, pitch and exact voice-to-silence ratios are not validated matching criteria in these sources.
Evidence from audiovisual ASMR does not automatically generalise to audio-only AI narration.
Positive preference does not establish relaxation or sleep benefit.
No fixed 5- or 10-minute therapeutic dose is established here.
logic: Narrator and voice delivery selection happen after the questionnaire.
All 20 questions have exactly A and B options.
metadata.frequency: Once at account creation; editable later

rules: All 20 questions are A/B choices, grouped into ASMR, narration and nature sounds.
Show all questions. Preferences within a disabled category are saved but inactive.
No narrator or voice-type selection occurs here.
Audio examples may be added later, matched in volume and changing one feature at a time. Do not imply unavailable samples can be played.

interpretation.method: Store each answer as a broad preference, not a permission, exclusion, diagnosis or fixed personality category.
rules: The account questionnaire never enables or disables ASMR, narration, nature sounds or exercises.
A preference does not require every session to contain that feature.
Session-specific choices decide which components and techniques are included.
Apply broad preferences only to components selected for the current session.
Keep alternatives broad and permit variation within each preference.
No technique permission can be inferred from activity level, attention orientation, preferred language or descriptive detail.
Do not infer voice gender, accent or pitch from these preferences.
Research informs the available approaches, but this questionnaire is not validated as a predictor of benefit.

post_questionnaire.instruction: Present four preview options after completion; save the selected ElevenLabs voice ID separately from questionnaire answers. Voice delivery settings may also be chosen here.

gemini_generation_guidance.principle: Treat choices as broad creative constraints, not scripts or literal scene instructions.
instructions: Vary settings, metaphors, openings, sensory details, structure and phrasing between sessions while respecting stored preferences and current-session exclusions.
water can include coastlines, streams, lakesides or gentle rain; land can include woodland, meadow, garden or gentle wind. These are examples, not required recurring settings.
Within an ASMR family, select available licensed sound assets. Do not invent assets or expect text-to-speech to create brushing or tapping reliably.
Choose techniques only from relevant reviewed evidence cards supplied by the application.
Use varied neutral narration if no allowed guided technique fits.
Do not force all 20 preferences into every script; use relevant fields for the selected session.
Use recent session history to reduce repeated scenes and wording.
Keep spoken narration separate from pauses, ASMR cues, ambient cues and citations.
Obtain current-session inclusion choices separately. Onboarding preferences alone never grant permission for breathing, body scans, muscle tensing or other guided exercises.
